newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 15.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 15.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- MSZOSZ, the largest association of Hungarian trade unions association, insists on an agreement about next year's prices and wages with the government and employees.
- Ferenc Vigh, army chief of staff said that the army's reform will be continued, but the duration of regular army service will not be reduced to nine months within one year.
- The chief of the national police asked policemen not to get impatient over the financial situation of the police, which will not improve until 1999.
- The police have confiscated a large amount of explosives in Budapest.
